# Clipper2 1.5.4 (vendored, s213)

Angus Johnson's polygon clipping and offsetting library --
github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2, tag Clipper2_1.5.4, CPP/Clipper2Lib
(src/ and include/ unchanged). Boost Software License 1.0 (LICENSE).

Composix uses the system's when CMake finds one (Fedora: clipper2-devel,
which Curvz also uses); otherwise this copy is built.
